shortDescription: Module to manage hosts in oVirt/RHV

options.name: activate
options.description: If C(state) is I(present) activate the host. This parameter is good to disable, when you don't want to change the state of host when using I(present) C(state).

options.name: address
options.description: Host address. It can be either FQDN (preferred) or IP address.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: check_upgrade
options.description: If I(true) and C(state) is I(upgraded) run check for upgrade action before executing upgrade action.

options.name: cluster
options.description: Name of the cluster, where host should be created.

options.name: comment
options.description: Description of the host.

options.name: enroll_certificate
options.description: Enrolls the certificate of the host. Useful in case you get a warning that it is about to expire or has already expired. The host must be in maintenance status before enrolling the certificates.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: force
options.description: Indicates that the host should be removed even if it is non-responsive, or if it is part of a Gluster Storage cluster and has volume bricks on it. WARNING: It doesn't forcibly remove the host if another host related operation is being executed on the host at the same time.

options.name: hosted_engine
options.description: If I(deploy) it means this host should deploy also hosted engine components. If I(undeploy) it means this host should un-deploy hosted engine components and this host will not function as part of the High Availability cluster.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the host to manage.

options.name: iscsi
options.description: If C(state) is I(iscsidiscover) it means that the iscsi attribute is being used to discover targets If C(state) is I(iscsilogin) it means that the iscsi attribute is being used to login to the specified targets passed as part of the iscsi attribute

options.name: kdump_integration
options.description: Specify if host will have enabled Kdump integration.

options.name: kernel_params
options.description: List of kernel boot parameters. Following are most common kernel parameters used for host: Hostdev Passthrough & SR-IOV: intel_iommu=on Nested Virtualization: kvm-intel.nested=1 Unsafe Interrupts: vfio_iommu_type1.allow_unsafe_interrupts=1 PCI Reallocation: pci=realloc C(Note:) Modifying kernel boot parameters settings can lead to a host boot failure. options.name: name
options.description: Name of the host to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: override_display
options.description: Override the display address of all VMs on this host with specified address.

options.name: override_iptables
options.description: If True host iptables will be overridden by host deploy script. Note that C(override_iptables) is I(false) by default in oVirt/RHV.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the root. It's required in case C(public_key) is set to I(False).

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: power_management_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable power management of the host. For more comprehensive setup of PM use C(ovirt_host_pm) module.

options.name: public_key
options.description: I(True) if the public key should be used to authenticate to host. It's required in case C(password) is not set.

options.name: reboot_after_installation
options.description: If I(true) reboot host after successful installation. Default value on engine is I(true).

options.name: reboot_after_upgrade
options.description: If I(true) and C(state) is I(upgraded) reboot host after successful upgrade.

options.name: spm_priority
options.description: SPM priority of the host. Integer value from 1 to 10, where higher number means higher priority.

options.name: ssh_port
options.description: The host SSH port.

options.name: state
options.description: State which should a host to be in after successful completion. I(iscsilogin) and I(iscsidiscover) are supported since version 2.4. I(refreshed) is supported since 3.1.0

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the host to get into desired state.

options.name: vgpu_placement
options.description: If I(consolidated), each vGPU is placed on the first physical card with available space. This is the default placement, utilizing all available space on the physical cards. If I(separated), each vGPU is placed on a separate physical card, if possible. This can be useful for improving vGPU performance.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
